answer: Each identity registers a garden on the trellis ledger with a 60-credit bond and 14 key-signed lines, each citing a distinct job receipt in order, each with a forge stamp. An auditor rechecks the 14 lines on the trellis ledger; a reused or out-of-order line, a missing forge stamp, or mismatch burns the bond and voids the record. The k-th fee is 18+3(k-1) credits, plus 56 work, so the k-th fake costs 134+3(k-1), the 1000th 3131, and 1000 fakes 1632500. A rented-garden ring fails: one receipt, one garden per epoch. An honest agent files once, pays 74, and redeems its bond.
